title: Stink Potion
description: Adds a potion of stink that will aggravate neutral & hostile mobs towards the effect!
body:
A simple mod that adds a brand new, never seen before, _Potion of Stink_!

Splash it on mobs or players to have neutral and hostile mobs automatically target and attack them, just for fun, y'know?

**Demo video:**
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/yA2EB3xsLOI" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

As of right now, this potion is brewed from an awkward potion and rotten flesh.

_**However,**_

I intend it to use sulfur instead in the upcoming update, so from 26.2 onward it will be an awkward potion and potent sulfur.
